## The Basics

Thank you for making a pull request. Before submitting, please read through these first:

- Checking a box is placing an `x` into the checkbox. E.g. `- [x]`.
- Add as much relevant information as you can. Vague or improper PRs are **more likely** to be closed.
- Keep a clean commit history so we don't have to squash.
- Talk to **AcousticJamm** BEFORE making any story/text changes or adding more areas.
- Pull requests which do not fill out the proper boxes are **more likely** to be closed.
- Pull requests which do not delete this text are **more likely** to be closed.


## Changes:

Describe your pull request here. Make sure to justify the changes, and why it should be accepted.
